categories.name: Surveys, tutorials and free books
categories.about: Overviews of learned certificates, safe learning, barrier functions, contraction and verification, plus free textbooks.

categories.name: Classical stability
categories.about: The founding results: governors, polynomial criteria, Lyapunov's method, Nyquist, LaSalle.

categories.name: Robust, nonlinear and hybrid stability
categories.about: Absolute stability, small gain, dissipativity, passivity, ISS, IQCs, contraction, switched systems and time delay.

categories.name: Computation and design with certificates
categories.about: Sum-of-squares, control Lyapunov and barrier functions, LQR-trees, hybrid zero dynamics.

categories.name: Learning with stability and safety guarantees
categories.about: Lyapunov-constrained RL, learned Lyapunov, barrier and contraction certificates, stable learned dynamics.

categories.name: Neural-network verification for control
categories.about: Exact and bound-propagation verifiers, Lipschitz bounds, quadratic constraints and verified neural controllers.

categories.name: Stability and safety on real robots
categories.about: Safety filters and stability-guided learning deployed on legged robots, humanoids and manipulators.
